title: AI Slop and Hallucinations in Vulnerability Assessment: A Survey on Reasoning Failures and Trustworthy Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25667v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into cybersecurity has transformed vulnerability assessment, but it has also produced a trustworthiness crisis driven by the unchecked proliferation of "AI slop." These artifacts, hallucinated vulnerabilities, plausible but incorrect patches, and semantically repackaged bug reports, impose a cognitive burden on human triage pipelines that mirrors a denial-of-service attack. This paper surveys the empirical evidence, identifies a unifying mechanism, and traces a path toward trustworthy triage. translated_title: 漏洞评估中的AI垃圾内容与幻觉现象：关于推理失败与可信缓解策略的综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25667v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）融入网络安全领域彻底改变了漏洞评估方式，但同时也引发了由“AI垃圾内容”无节制泛滥所驱动的可信度危机。这些产物——幻觉生成的漏洞、看似合理却错误的补丁、以及语义上重新包装的缺陷报告——给人工分诊流程带来了认知负担，其效果类似于一次拒绝服务攻击。本文综述了相关实证证据，识别出一个统一的机制，并勾勒出通往可信分诊的路径。我们基于结构化文献综述形式化了AI垃圾内容的分类体系，并剖析了其根本原因：安全专家的因果演绎推理与当前大语言模型自回归概率生成之间的鸿沟。我们通过一个可测量的代理指标——演绎覆盖率得分——将这一鸿沟操作化，并表明思维链提示和使用工具的智能体可以缩小（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本综述揭示了LLM在漏洞评估中产生的“AI垃圾内容”（幻觉漏洞、错误补丁、重包装报告）的根源在于安全专家的因果演绎推理与模型自回归概率生成之间的根本鸿沟，并提出了演绎覆盖率得分作为可测量指标，以及思维链提示与工具增强智能体等可信缓解路径。
en_tdlr: This survey reveals that "AI slop" in LLM-based vulnerability assessment (hallucinated vulnerabilities, flawed patches, repackaged bug reports) stems from the gap between security experts' causal deductive reasoning and LLMs' autoregressive probabilistic generation, proposing the Deductive Coverage Score as a measurable proxy and outlining trustworthy mitigation via chain-of-thought prompting and tool-using agents.
